lyra_gc07_exp_manual_triangulation.title: Manual Harmonic Triangulation
lyra_gc07_exp_manual_triangulation.interpretation: Without optional capability combinations, the player and Lyra still derive the counterphase by comparing repeated failures and manually triangulating the stable inverse pattern.

lyra_gc07_exp_structural_counterphase.title: Structural Counterphase
lyra_gc07_exp_structural_counterphase.interpretation: Willow's slow-system cognition and Gronk's constraint reading let the player identify which crypt structures carry the repeating failure and derive the inverse from those load paths.

lyra_gc07_exp_adversarial_countermodel.title: Adversarial Countermodel
lyra_gc07_exp_adversarial_countermodel.interpretation: Elara's contradiction-first method and Lyra's adversarial calibration let the player model the failure as an opponent, predict its next phase, and derive the stable inverse.

lyra_gc07_exp_counterphase_derived.title: Counterphase Is a Principle
lyra_gc07_exp_counterphase_derived.interpretation: The crypt's old failures reveal a reusable counterphase principle: the network can be prepared to answer the Echo's repeating structure instead of merely absorbing each local event.

lyra_memory_gc07_counterphase_principle.title: A Counterphase, Not Another Patch
lyra_memory_gc07_counterphase_principle.summary: In the Chrono-Crypt, you and Lyra turned repeated harmonic failures into a reusable counterphase principle. The next problem is preparing a network that can actually use it.
lyra_memory_gc07_counterphase_principle.protagonistView: The crypt did not give us a weapon. It gave us a rule for how the network must answer the Echo.
lyra_memory_gc07_counterphase_principle.targetView: The player can now carry an adversarial insight beyond this room without confusing the derivation with the final decision.
